title: Read an ambiguous expression grammar
description: An ambiguous grammar permits more than one parse tree for the same input. You can see both arithmetic operators share the same nonterminal here.

steps.description: %token declares ID as a token. The %% marker begins the grammar rules.
e can combine two expressions with + or *, or derive ID. Both operator alternatives refer to e on each side.
The closing marker ends the grammar rules. The page uses this grammar to inspect shift/reduce conflicts, where shifting and reducing compete in one table cell.
